$description: The rules every colour ramp in primitives.scss is derived from. scripts/derive-colour-ramps.js checks primitives.scss against them (npm run audit:tokens), and Design Tokens/Colour Ramps draws them. Change a rule here, then run the script with --write; never edit a ramp value by hand.

navy.fit: Fitted to the hand-set values it replaced, every step within deltaE 2. The hue turns toward violet as it lightens, so the pale steps read as navy rather than grey-cyan.

burgundy.fit: Fitted to the hand-set values it replaced, every step within deltaE 2.

azure.fit: Fitted to the hand-set values it replaced, which already sat at the sRGB limit. The curve peaks high, at L 0.77, so the gamut caps most of the steps lighter than the anchor.

indigo.fit: Moved onto the shared ladder. The brand anchor sits on the curve between steps 400 and 500 rather than on a step.

teal.role: Code-block backgrounds, and art derived from Candor.
teal.fit: Fitted through both code-block backgrounds, teal-115 in light and teal-870 in dark. Two low-chroma anchors give a quiet grey-green, a sibling of the cool greys.

red.fit: Status ramps share one curve shape (g = 1), so how vivid a status colour is at a lightness has one answer. K passes the curve through the light error text from before it had a ramp.

gold.fit: Shares the status curve shape. K passes the curve through the light warning text from before it had a ramp.

green.fit: Shares the status curve shape. K passes the curve through the light success text from before it had a ramp.

navy.670: --color-tooltip-bg (dark): far enough from a modal to stand apart (the deltaE 10 held for the tooltip), while white text still clears its floor. navy-700 sat too close to the modal, and navy-600 is too light for the text.

azure.250: --color-link (dark): clears the text floor on a modal (bg-elevated) as well as the page, which azure-300 did not.

indigo.250: --color-link-visited (dark): clears the text floor on a modal as well as the page.
indigo.625: --color-link-visited (light): clears the text floor on a card with margin, where indigo-600 sat on it.

teal.115: --color-bg-code (light): one of the two backgrounds the teal curve was fitted through.
